> Student developer from Delhi, India. Builds systems, products and ideas into reality — AI-powered apps, backend systems, automation, Telegram bots and infrastructure. B.Tech student at MAIT.

Saksham Swaroop (handle **VIP-saksham**) is a student developer from Delhi, India.
He builds hackathon platforms, agriculture decision-intelligence products, VPS
hosting tooling, Telegram music bots and binary-level editor experiments, and is
open to collaborations and internships.

Languages: English, Hindi. Site content available in English, Russian and Chinese.

## Selected projects
- AICTE Compliance OS — Smart India Hackathon 2026 grand-finalist project (compliance platform for AICTE norms).
- M2M — Mitti to Market — full-stack agricultural marketplace with AI-assisted crop assessment (OpenCV / PyTorch) and SELL / STORE / PROCESS decisions.
- Telegram Music Bots — KeyaraMusic and related music-bot builds: playback, streaming, automation, database-backed settings.
- NikoPad — developer-focused text & code editor prototype engineered into the Notepad++ 8.9.8 x64 binary via PE resource modification (GPLv3).
- NEXHOST / BotCloud — VPS hosting and deployment platform (private, in active development).
- REA — personal automation project (private, early development).
